name: Kolkar Leaders
summary: Regthar Deathgate moves against Kolkar leaders gathering strength in the Barrens. The nomadic centaur have plagued the tauren for generations. Now new chieftains are uniting scattered bands into a military threat, and Regthar sends Horde champions against Barak Kodobane at the Forgotten Pools before his influence spreads.

sections.title: A Rising Menace in the Drylands
sections.body: Centaur have terrorized Kalimdor for countless years. Before Thrall's Horde arrived and turned the tide, they drove the nomadic tauren nearly to extinction. In the Barrens, the dominant Kolkar tribe usually roams in scattered marauding bands. Now aggressive chieftains are joining those bands together, making raiders strong enough to challenge the Horde's fortified outposts.

sections.title: Decapitating the Beast
sections.body: Regthar Deathgate, an orc warrior, is stationed in an encampment west of the Crossroads. He knows boldness and brute force hold the Kolkar together. Without strong commanders, their raiders fall to infighting. So Regthar sends Horde champions against the leaders to blunt their advance. Barak Kodobane, an ambitious chieftain, is the first target. He is camped near the waters of the Forgotten Pools.

sections.title: The First of Many
sections.body: Barak Kodobane's death weakens the northern Kolkar encampments. Regthar knows Barak is only the first in a broader movement. His death opens a campaign against the Kolkar high command. Next come fellow chieftains Verog the Dervish and Hezrul Bloodmark, scattered across the Barrens.

faq.answer: Barak Kodobane is a fierce Kolkar centaur leader who rallied marauders around the Forgotten Pools north of the Crossroads. His wit and cruelty made him more dangerous than ordinary nomadic raiders. He organized scattered clans into an offensive threat against the Horde.

faq.q: Where can I find Barak Kodobane?
faq.answer: Barak Kodobane camps at the Forgotten Pools, an oasis north of the Crossroads in the central Barrens. Loyal Kolkar guards usually surround him.

Regthar Deathgate is an orc veteran at a small bunker camp just west of the Crossroads. He watches centaur movements in the Barrens and plans pre-emptive strikes to protect Horde settlements from organized raids.

faq.q: Why are the Kolkar such a problem for the Horde?
faq.answer: The centaur have waged a ruthless war against the tauren for generations, bringing them near to extinction. As members of the Horde, the tauren rely on their allies to protect ancestral hunting grounds and trade routes across the Barrens from continued centaur expansion.

faq.q: What happens after Barak is killed?
faq.answer: Barak Kodobane's defeat reveals that other chieftains are gathering forces elsewhere in the Barrens. Regthar sends you after Verog the Dervish at the Stagnant Oasis, then Hezrul Bloodmark at the Lushwater Oasis. A direct Kolkar assault must then be met.

faq.q: Why do the Kolkar gather around the oases?
faq.answer: The Kolkar gather around oases because water and fertile ground are precious in the Barrens' dry climate. By taking springs such as the Forgotten Pools, they secure water and deny travelers and tauren hunters places to rest.

angles.text: As a tauren, striking down Kolkar commanders means survival and vengeance. Centaur clans slaughtered tribes and drove the shu'halo from their ancestral pastures for decades before the Horde gained a foothold in Kalimdor.

As an orc, you know Thrall pledged the Horde to defend the tauren. Veterans such as Regthar Deathgate honor that blood-oath and treat centaur warmongers as immediate threats to orcish sovereignty in the Barrens.

As a member of the Horde, you depend on the Barrens crossroads, which connect Mulgore, Durotar, and distant Horde outposts. Breaking Kolkar leadership protects fragile supply caravans from devastating ambushes.
